profile_text.body:
Broadcom Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker AVGO, headquartered in Palo Alto, California, and listed with the SEC under CIK 0001730168. On its own website the company says it delivers semiconductors and infrastructure software for global enterprises' most complex, mission-critical needs, and describes itself as connecting everything.

The material available does not list specific Broadcom products, AI offerings, or MCP servers, so no product-level detail can be reported. What is on record is the company's litigation exposure, which sits in California with 281 matters counted there. No individual cases are named in the available facts.
